items.t: Amazon, Target and Walmart Chase Holiday Toy Spending
items.sum: Popular toys, gaming consoles and electronic devices are driving competition among retailers during the holiday shopping season.

items.t: Target stock technicals amid Black Friday
items.sum: Investing.com -- Target Corporation (TGT) is technically Strong Buy on both daily and weekly readings. At $171.93 as of Nov 27, 10:13 AM EST, it is close to the 52-week high of $176.73.

items.t: Target’s Former CEO Just Sold $4.4 Million of Stock Heading Into Black Friday
items.sum: Target's executive chair cashed out shares at a two-year high just before the holiday rush, and the Form 4 offers no explanation. Strong sales and traffic back the rally, yet one-time refunds are propping up the numbers.

items.t: Shoppers helped pay Trump’s tariffs. Now Target, Best Buy, and Kohl’s are booking $387 million in refunds
items.sum: The three retailers booked $387 million in refund benefits last quarter, while Walmart and Target say they're cutting prices rather than paying shoppers back.

items.t: Target cut its Apple Black Friday discount in half
items.sum: There are two Target rules customers should know before buying.

items.t: Target, Kohl’s and JCPenney use Black Friday freebies to lure shoppers
items.sum: Shoppers can score free gift cards worth up to $1,000, collectible snow globes and other surprises — if they get there early.
